insights: Caller context must be constrained for cacheable queries: use covered argument attributes rather than arbitrary caller traversal. Borrowed simplified values may belong to caller and need ownership checks before analysis as callee values.
Maintain per-query SimplifiedValues, dead blocks, known successors, SROA allocations and constant pointer offsets. Scope/lifetimes are separate from scoring.
Accumulate speculative SROA and load-elimination benefits, then reverse saved costs when escapes or conflicting uses invalidate the opportunity. Avoid retaining profitability facts past invalidation.
Threshold query may stop early; full estimates/features request complete analysis. Initial maximal bonuses permit early rejection only with a monotonic remaining-cost argument.
128-bit cost-benefit products combine per-block savings and entry/callsite frequencies; missing or zero counts disable the profile path, with fallback to unitless estimates.
Explicit profile policy distinguishes instrumented versus other profiles. User overrides target defaults only when explicitly present.
Cost-benefit decision has accept/reject/fallback bands; integer cross-products avoid division rounding. Tiny callee allowance and exclusion of never-executed code are heuristic policy.

Vector, single-block, call convention and hot/cold bonuses include documented arbitrary/default historical factors. Measure Ink target-specific alternatives instead of importing numeric magic constants.
Nested devirtualization analysis disables further indirect boosting to bound nested speculative cost. Calls charge arguments and target-specific penalties.
Feature extraction shares generic analysis but still duplicates some cost policy; source TODOs warn of heuristic contamination. Keep raw model features distinct from preset bonuses.
Inline assembly instruction counting intentionally excludes some outlined sections; cost models disclose unsupported/approximate regions rather than pretending exactness.

PHI joins skip dead predecessor edges and self edges; retain a constant or base/offset only when surviving inputs agree. Select with unknown condition similarly retains agreeing constant arms. F068 implements corresponding exact literal joins in Ink cost descriptions.
Pointer offset identities use target DataLayout/address-space widths and inbounds restrictions. Ink must use its checked codec/range meaning rather than importing LLVM pointer or nowrap assumptions.
Constant GEP/bitcast costs and FP conversion library-call penalties are target hypotheses, not universal zero-cost source operations.
Dynamic-to-static allocation can increase unconditional stack pressure; code uses saturating size arithmetic, recursion-sensitive stack budgets and acknowledges scalable-vector underestimation.
Callsite nonnull attributes and stack provenance enable context facts; caller memoization is bounded by explicit covered attributes. Facts must not outlive source or lexical context in Ink.

Recursive comparison simplification restricts to a single predecessor and a condition that makes the recursive branch stop after one unfolding. General unrolling needs termination and growth evidence.
Cold callsites in GPU kernels can still affect hot-path register occupancy because allocation is whole-function. Mean call frequency alone cannot predict GPU resource pressure.

Hot/cold profile decisions fall back from callsite to callee only when callsite evidence is unavailable, and target multipliers apply afterward. Override precedence can intentionally replace rather than maximize thresholds.
Loads remain speculative savings only while stores/calls do not clobber them; current conservative model rolls back all savings on a clobber and documents MemorySSA as a possible refinement.

Caller aggregate extract-value folding may use caller-owned simplified values explicitly, while most analysis rejects such values. Cross-scope exceptions must be deliberate and tied to preserved ownership.
Indirect devirtualization requires the resolved function type to match the call signature. An unresolved readonly call differs from a call that may write when invalidating load savings.

Intrinsic eligibility, memory copying, returns-twice, recursive calls, varargs and escaping block addresses are independent constraints. An expensive cost or a cost override cannot substitute for complete legality checks in Ink.
One return and unconditional control-flow edges are modeled free after inlining; switches use target jump-table/case-cluster estimates and explicitly omit mixed lowering forms.
Debug/pseudo instructions are excluded so instrumentation does not change vector-density heuristics. Diagnostics retain instruction-before/after cost and threshold changes without becoming authority.
Transitive dead-block discovery requires every incoming edge dead; breadth-first live-block traversal avoids unrelated source blocks and uses a growing deduplicated worklist.
Ephemeral-value analyses are cached per function only with the provided analysis lifetime. Ink executable fallible contracts cannot be treated as proof-only ephemera.
A sole-use local callee with noduplicate work can be moved by inlining without duplicating that work. Distinguish removing/moving a definition from copying it.

Target feature and strict floating compatibility are checked even with always-inline requests. Coroutine phase, noinline/optnone/flatten order and interposable/loader-replaceable definitions have distinct policy semantics.
TargetLibraryInfo from legacy manager is copied because later queries overwrite its storage. Capture input values before another callback invalidates borrowed analysis state.

Byval call setup estimates copied words with a capped8-store heuristic, explicitly identified as a target-data limitation. Use measured representation/ownership costs for Ink rather than copying that constant.

Full cost/features wrappers can return no result on mechanical analysis failure. The header feature promise must be read with the implementation failure path; inability to compute a feature is not a numeric zero.
Diagnostic annotation pass changes an analysis-print flag and reports preserved IR; its default thresholds/features do not prove any transformation or observed speed gain.
